items.title: 6.7 Model ki jaanch aur karkardagi ke pemaane (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.7 before its first sub-heading (PDF 85-85); each sub-heading has its own lesson.

blocks.text: Model evaluation (model ki jaanch) ka matlab hai dekhna ke machine learning model kitna achha kaam karta hai. Is mein model ke andazon ki quality aise test data par napi jati hai jo training mein istemal nahi hua. Is se model ki khoobiyan aur kamzoriyan saamne aati hain. Performance metrics woh pemaane hain jin se napa jata hai ke model kitna theek chal raha hai. Masle ki qism ke mutabiq alag metrics istemal hote hain, jo neeche bayan hain:

blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Zyada accuracy wala model bhi kuch cases mein ghalat results de sakta hai. Isi liye precision aur recall jaise doosre pemaane bhi istemal hote hain. Theek jaanch se model ki asal performance samajh aati hai.
